subject: Replacement req: open role for Serving/Inference (replacement) and interview cadence
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: TalentOps <talentops@hireflow.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — request to open and proposed cadence

Hi TalentOps / Marissa,

We need to open a replacement req for a Serving/Inference engineer on the Serving team (this is a backfill for S3 who left last month). Strong preference for someone with production LLM inference experience (Kv-cache, dynamic batching, quantized runtimes). Key constraints: must be available to start by end of Q1; team is on-call — candidate needs oncall experience.

Ask: please create the req and route for approval. I attach the draft job-spec and a small org chart to show team slippage if we don't refill. Proposed posting title: "Senior Inference Engineer (Serving)". Suggested level: S3 / Senior (open to S4 if market warrants). Budget code: ENG-SERV-2026-BACKFILL.

I'll need the posting live for initial candidate screening by Dec 6. Please confirm timeline and any missing approvals. If we can, I'd like the interview cadence to be: 1) 45m take-home/code screen, 2) 60m system-design + serving runtime deep-dive, 3) final comp + manager sync.

Attachments: job-spec-serving-inference.pdf, org-chart-serving-team.pdf

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, TalentOps <talentops@hireflow.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — request to open and proposed cadence

Thanks Irene — filing this now.

Quick plan:
- I will create the GH job posting with the title you suggested and route to the approvals queue today.
- Proposed interview panel: Laura (Hiring mgr, manager interview & comp), Priyom Das (system design / inference runtime), one IC (peer coding), and a CS / oncall-ops screen.
- Sourcing channels: Hired, LinkedIn Recruiter, internal referrals.
- Timeline: post live by 2026-12-01; first screens week of 2026-12-06.

Question: do you want the take-home to be a small perf-oriented notebook (preferred) or a short code challenge? I recommend a short perf notebook with a tiny model inference micro-benchmark so we can evaluate familiarity with batching/kv cache.

I attached the candidate-facing job spec I will post (job-spec-serving-inference.pdf). Also attaching a brief candidate slate template I'll use once sourcing begins.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
Attachments: job-spec-serving-inference.pdf, candidate-slate-template.xlsx

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — request to open and proposed cadence

I approve the req in principle. Two caveats:
1) Keep comp band within S3 target range unless clearly compelling (benchmarks + 2 panel approvals) — finance sign-off required above S3 midpoint.
2) I'm okay with the take-home notebook but we'd like a short timebox (48-72h) and a strict rubric. Recruiter to collect rubrics with each candidate.

Marissa — please attach the conditional budget approval here once you have it so I can sign off formally (attach budget-approval-conditional.pdf). Laura, Priyom — please confirm availability to sit on the technical panel (aim for two interviewers: one design, one implementation).

-Markus
Markus Klein
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: TalentOps <talentops@hireflow.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 10:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — request to open and proposed cadence

All set — job posted live (GH #12345). I also have an initial inbound who looks promising: Aria Singh (resumé attached). Aria completed an initial phone screen with our recruiting sourcer and is available next week.

Proposed interview schedule (candidate local TZ PST):
- Tue 2026-12-08 10:00–10:45: Take-home briefing / short screening (Marissa)
- Wed 2026-12-09 11:00–12:00: System design & serving runtime deep-dive (Priyom + Laura)
- Fri 2026-12-11 14:00–14:30: Manager + comp sync (Irene)

I've attached Aria's resume and added calendar invites; TalentOps is looped for the take-home packaging.

Attachments: candidate-aria-singh-resume.pdf

—Marissa

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Nov 2026 18:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — post-interview notes (Aria Singh)

Quick debrief after today's session (system design + runtime):
- Strengths: clear mental model of KV cache behavior; practical trade-offs on batching vs latency; good questions about safe rollouts.
- Concerns: limited production tuning experience at 8k token sequences (mostly worked on shorter contexts); took a while on one micro-optimization question.
- Recommendation: proceed to manager sync + final onsite if compensation expectations align. Prefer a 2:1 hiring decision (Priyom + Laura) before offer.

Attached: interview-feedback-aria.docx (detailed notes + rubric).

Laura Bennett
Staff Engineer, Serving
Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, TalentOps <talentops@hireflow.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2026 10:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Replacement req for Serving/Inference engineer — next steps and offer authority

Thanks team. Laura & Priyom — thanks for the detailed notes. I agree we should move Aria to the manager + comp sync and hold final decision with a 2:1 pass. Markus — please confirm compensation authority up to S3 midpoint; if you sign off I will instruct TalentOps to begin offer prep.

Marissa/TalentOps: once Markus confirms, please open the req in GH for "offer in progress" and circulate the offer draft for comp sign-off. Use budget-approval-conditional.pdf as the baseline.

Irene Choi
Director, Serving Infrastructure
Redwood Inference
